polls.description: Trump administration creates new 'Super Intelligence Force' with multiple appointed leaders to control and regulate AI development amid growing national security concerns.
polls.question: Is Trump's Super Intelligence Force necessary or government overreach?

cluster_stories.summary: The task force will reach out to consumers, public interest groups, religious organizations, critical infrastructure providers and AI companies, Trump said.

cluster_stories.title: Trump Names Clayton, Ferguson to Lead AI Task Force
cluster_stories.summary: The “Super Intelligence Force” will be led by Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton and chairman of the Federal Trade Commission Andrew Ferguson, President Donald Trump says on Truth Social.
cluster_stories.headline: TRUMP FORMS 'SUPER INTELLIGENCE FORCE' - Clayton and Ferguson to Lead

cluster_stories.title: Elon Musk says SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI after Trump's 'super intelligence' push
cluster_stories.summary: The plan comes days after Trump signed an executive order directing federal agencies to use the term. The order, signed on September 29, 2026, replaces "artificial intelligence" with "Super Intelligence," or "SI," on official websites, policy documents and government press releases.
cluster_stories.headline: MUSK RENAMES SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI After Trump's 'Super Intelligence' Order

cluster_stories.title: Trump forms 'Super Intelligence Force' to cement US dominance in next-gen AI
cluster_stories.summary: In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote, "Following the Historic White House Accord on Super Intelligence, where the World's most important Technology Companies came together, and confirmed their responsibilities to the American People, I am announcing the formation of the Super Intelligence Force (SIF)."
cluster_stories.headline: SUPER INTELLIGENCE FORCE Formed to Cement US AI Dominance
